messages:
alex: Heads up — demand model shows a ~32% GPU-hour shortfall in ap-southeast for Aug 7-14. Marketing demo + two large trials. Need quick plan: bin‑packing tweaks, backfill, and fairness guardrails. Ideas?

maria: Which forecast run is this from and what are the raw numbers?

alex: From demand-forecaster v2 (last run 1923400000). Baseline = 120k GPUh/week, projected = 158k GPUh/week -> delta ~38k GPUh. Region split: us-west +10k, eu-west +5k, ap-southeast +23k.

tony: 23k in ap-south-east is painful. Short term we can: increase preemptible pool, enable aggressive backfill, and reduce guaranteed headroom for burst tenants. But watch fairness.

alex: Proposed quick actions: 1) temporary backfill pool in ap-southeast (16-32 GPUs) for 10-14 days; 2) enable compact packing/cross-tenant co-location for <=4 GPU jobs; 3) canary a packing mode for large jobs to reduce fragmentation.

sarah: Fragmentation is a big part — large 8+ GPU requests leave 1-2 GPU holes. We should run canary that enforces slab-style packing for classes [8,4,1] on a subset of nodes, and a separate canary that tries "best-fit-decreasing" compaction.

maria: Cost tradeoffs: more backfill + preemptible capacity reduces tail latency risk but increases churn and potential uplift in instance spin-ups. Rough estimate: +$6k/week if we add 50% more preemptible capacity in APAC due to cross-region spill and egress. Need finance sign-off for anything beyond 32 GPUs.

devops-bot: ALERT: current cluster util ap-southeast: 94% packed; fragmentation_metric=0.37; preemptible_available=12 GPUs; reserved_pool_free=4 GPUs.

tony: For an immediate, low-risk move: set preemptible_ratio=0.2 (was 0.1), eviction_timeout=45s (was 30s), and spin up backfill_pool=32 for 14d. Also enable compact packing for small jobs only. Config snippet: 
```
policy:
  preemptible_ratio: 0.2
  eviction_timeout: 45s
  backfill_pool_size: 32
  packing_mode: compact_small_jobs_only
```

maria: Doubling preemptible_ratio will bump eviction churn. Which tenants are marked non-preemptible? We should whitelist enterprise customers. Also set a guardrail: if tail_latency_99 > 1.5x baseline then revert.

alex: Agree on guardrails. Also consider cross-region spillover: route non-data-sensitive best-effort workloads from ap-southeast to us-west for next 10 days. That can buy ~8-12k GPUh. Any objections?

sarah: I can run two canaries today — 1) slab-like packing on 10% nodes in ap-southeast, 2) compact_small_jobs_only packing on a different 10%. I’ll post before/after fragmentation metrics and eviction counts. Target start 15:00 UTC.

maria: Please update dashboards and add alerts: eviction_rate > 0.08, tail_latency_99 > 1.5x baseline, fragmentation_metric > 0.45. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/prod/infra/packing and https://grafana.redwood/prod/infra/costs

alex: Who can flip the backfill pool now? Want to limit blast radius and TTL.

tony: I can run it. Command: `./ops toggle-backfill --region ap-southeast --gpus 32 --ttl 14d --qos best-effort`

ops-bot: canary scheduled by sarah for 1923457800, backfill toggle queued by tony, will post run logs.

alex: OK let’s move. Keep comms tight. Post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

sarah: Running canaries at 15:00 UTC — will snapshot current node packing, then enable modes, collect logs for 2 hours and share results here.

maria: After initial results we should make a decision on cross-region routing and finance sign-off if we go >32 GPUs.

tony: Also a reminder — update tenant-rate-limiter rules so we don’t accidentally allow a single tenant to soak the new backfill pool.

alex: ack. thanks everyone.
